title: Perfect Stovetop White Rice
description: Fluffy, separate grains of long-grain white rice every time: rinse, measure, simmer covered, then rest. No rice cooker needed.
equipment: Medium saucepan with a tight-fitting lid

image.alt: A bowl of fluffy white rice

ingredients.item: long-grain white rice or jasmine rice

steps.text: Rinse the rice in the sieve under cold running water, swishing it with your hand, until the water runs mostly clear, about {time 1 min notimer}. Drain well.
Put the rice, water, salt and butter or oil in the saucepan and bring to a boil over high heat.
Stir once, cover tightly, turn the heat to its lowest setting and cook without lifting the lid for {time 18 min}.
Take the pan off the heat and let it stand, still covered, for {time 10 min}. Fluff with a fork and serve.

notes: The rest off the heat finishes cooking the top layer and firms up the grains, so don’t skip it.
Brown rice needs more water (about 2½ cups per 1½ cups rice) and about 45 minutes.
